overall_summary: Data volume is very low, yielding low statistical confidence. However, a clear outlier emerged with family/relationship dynamics—specifically the husband-wife emotional video ('or5gtaBpRVY') outperforming others significantly at 1.5K views. Content focusing on domestic relationships and emotional relationship dynamics resonates much better than generic brotherly/sisterly or motivational clips in this initial sample.

winning_patterns.evidence: Wife/Husband emotional video (or5gtaBpRVY) gained 1,523 views, which is nearly 7x higher than the channel average.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on husband-wife and complex relationship themes rather than broad sibling or generic motivational topics.

weak_patterns.pattern: Low-performing Sibling or Generic Family Shorts
weak_patterns.evidence: Sister emotional videos (jfmMztnam_A, fAAoIQCRMXU) scored extremely low views (16 and 111 views respectively).
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize standalone sibling emotional tropes for the immediate future to conserve effort.
